summary:
S06a covers the Layout Editor panels (LE/40) and the four scrapbooks (LE/55-58). TV has 41 files and 22,564 lines here; VV has 30 files and 12,302 lines.

**Naming.** No folder or module renaming is needed: the folder numbers, file names and namespaces already match. VV must create LE/58__Feature__ScrapbookSpecification. The server and transport names that differ are VV-owned and should stay (DIV-4). VV restarted its version numbers at 1.0.0 for every file it ported, so a VV number does not say which TV state it holds.

**Panels.**
- VV is well behind on the PanelHost (1.4.0 vs 1.6.0), the Toolbar (about TV 1.12.0 vs 1.24.0), the Viewport panel (1.4.1 vs 1.10.0), Dimensions (1.4.0 vs 1.7.0), Vectors (1.8.0 vs 1.9.0) and Layers (1.1.0 vs 1.3.0).
- VV still shows Undo, Redo, Fit, 100% and Notes on the toolbar, which TV removed. It lacks 11 TV tools and toggles, each tied to a TV-only system.
- VV has no left-column tabs and no tab hover text.

**Real defects found.**
- VV Panel__Text never calls Many(): with several items selected the boxes show the new-text defaults.
- Both apps' AppConfig multi-select notes contradict the panel's behaviour, because the config wins over the code fallback.
- VV's Vectors panel repaints every selected fill when Edges is unticked on several shapes.
- VV's ViewportLink lacks the FactsPatch fix, so a viewport name with odd spacing dirties the sheet on every visit.
- TV is missing scrapbook category folders 02-05 on disk, so saving into them fails there.
- TV still lacks VV's Add Viewport list refresh (an open back-port).

**Parametric Scrapbook.** VV holds the TV v2.85 state (engine 1.2.0 vs 1.7.0). VV shows 3 tiles; TV ships 11 and shows 10 on an architectural sheet.
- Universal and portable: Cabinet Infill, the drawing title with its bar to the right, and Area Schedule (the last one with Floor Areas).
- NA-specific or site-plan only: ProjectQr, SiteLegend, and the empty Standard config.
- TV's Panel__ScrapbookParametric statically imports NA-only modules and TV's CfApi client, so VV cannot take it whole until a TV refactor or an adapted VV panel.

**Specification Scrapbook (LE/58).** Absent in VV. It needs PanelHost, TileDrag and SpecData exports first, and its row editor needs SpellCheck plus a VV transport (a WCP route for the notes file and a dictionary blueprint).

**Cross-cutting.**
- A drawing-type API stub in VV's SheetModel would remove six site-plan seams.
- Porting the pure ViewportRotation leaf early unblocks four files.
- VV measures paper text in Helvetica while drawing it in Open Sans.
- VV ships under a shared service worker whose token has not moved since 18-Sep.

The report has 57 findings, 13 decisions and 13 work packages with acceptance checks, hot files and tests to port.

findings.title: Slice folders already aligned; only LE/58 is missing in VV
findings.detail: 40__Ui__Panels, 55__Feature__Scrapbook, 56__Feature__ScrapbookCustom and 57__Feature__ScrapbookParametric have the same numbers and file names in both apps. So does the app-root 51__LayoutEditor__UserScrapbookContent with its 00-05 category folders. No renumbering is needed. TV's 58__Feature__ScrapbookSpecification (5 files, 2,220 lines) has no VV counterpart and must be created at the same number.
findings.recommendation: Keep the numbers. Create VV LE/58__Feature__ScrapbookSpecification/ with TV's file names when WP-S06a-06 runs (S06a-F45).
findings.evidence: drift_all.tsv: LE/40,55,56,57 pair 1:1; LE/58 tv-only x5

findings.title: Module names identical; identity only in headers, console prefix, server names
findings.detail: Every shared file keeps TV's file name, namespace and exports (Na__LePanels, Na__LeToolbar, Na__LeScrap*, Na__LeParam*); no shared file has a VV-only export. The differences are the header line, the console prefix [ValeVision3D LayoutEditor] and a few strings. Server-side, VV deliberately uses WCP/Server__ValeVisionScrapbook__Api__.py, blueprint valevision_scrapbook_api and routes /api/valevision/scrapbook, where TV uses ProjectVision__TrueVisionScrapbook__Api__.py, truevision_scrapbook_api and /api/truevision/scrapbook.
findings.recommendation: No renames. Record the server file, blueprint and route names as permanent VV-owned divergences (DIV-4) in the ledger.
findings.evidence: WCP/server.py:95-96; NAAPPS/ProjectVision__LocalServer__Main__.py:67,234; extract.py export diff

findings.title: VV version numbers do not map to TV's (restart at 1.0.0; duplicates)
findings.detail: Whole-file ports restarted at 1.0.0: VV Scrapbook 1.0.0 = TV 1.1.0; Panel__Scrapbook 1.0.0 = 1.2.0; engine 1.0.0 = 1.2.0; ViewportLink 1.0.0 = 1.2.0; Grips 1.0.0 = 1.1.0; LinkNoodle 1.0.0 = 1.2.0; Panel__ScrapbookParametric 1.0.0 = 1.2.0. VV Toolbar's log lists 1.8.0 and 1.9.0 twice each, out of order. TV ViewportLink has two different 1.3.0 entries. Files with equal numbers can still differ (Panel__Sheet 1.4.0, Panel__Text 1.4.0).
findings.recommendation: Adopt TV's version number on every whole-file port, logged 'Ported from TrueVision3D x.y.z' (D-S06a-06). Renumber VV Toolbar's log and TV ViewportLink's second 1.3.0 as hygiene.
findings.evidence: VV LE/57/*.js logs 'Version 1.0.0 - Ported from TrueVision3D's 1.2.0'; VV Toolbar__.js:31-49; TV ViewportLink__.js:128-139

findings.title: PanelHost 1.4.0 lacks LinkedPairRow, tab hints, palette, slider box
findings.detail: TV 1.6.0 adds: LinkedPairRow/ShowLink (1.2.0, v2.41.0; the only exports VV lacks); spec.hint tab hover text (1.5.0, v2.91.0); Na__ColourPalette__Attach on every colour input (1.6.0, v2.126.0), a static import from top-level 54__Feature__ColourPalette; and an unversioned typable number box beside every slider (rangebox). Everything else is identical, including AdvancedToggle.
findings.recommendation: Take TV 1.6.0 whole with a header seam. Until 54__Feature__ColourPalette exists in VV, leave out its import and the Attach line as a marked seam, then restore them.
findings.evidence: git diff -w: VV +32/-160; TV PanelHost__.js:45-91 log; extract: TV-only exports LinkedPairRow, ShowLink

findings.title: Panel stylesheet lacks TV regions (pair, rangebox, ref/red, wrap)
findings.detail: VV lacks: the Linked Pair region (v2.41.0); .na-le-input--rangebox and .na-le-range-suffix; toggle-group flex-wrap and --tight (v2.140.0, 1:200); .na-le-row__inline-check (Hide swings); .na-le-btn--ref; and the one-red rule for Off, Unlock and Ref (v2.123.0, v2.154.0). findings.title: Toolbar keeps Undo/Redo/Fit/100%/Notes that TV removed
findings.detail: TV 1.19.0 (v2.124.0) removed Undo, Redo, Fit and the zoom readout; the keys and right-click Zoom to fit remain. TV 1.17.0 removed Notes, because the Margin Notes panel owns that switch. VV still shows all five (Toolbar__.js:292,318-319,323-324), listens for History and zoom events, and imports History, Navigation and SheetSurface zoom. VV already has right-click Zoom to fit and 'Show notes margin', so removing them is safe.

findings.evidence: VV Toolbar__.js:110,292,318-324; TV Toolbar__.js log 1.17.0/1.19.0; VV SheetTools__ContextMenu__.js:101,217; VV Panel__MarginNotes__.js:80

findings.title: Toolbar lacks 11 TV tools and toggles (TV 1.24.0)
findings.detail: VV lacks: Draft (v2.107.0); Grid and Grid Snap (v2.114.0); Ortho (v2.113.0); Axes (v2.131.0); the Snap split button and menu (v2.129.0); Circle and Arc (v2.130.0); Floor Area (v2.104.0); Image (v2.116.0); the Vector quality select (v2.136.0); Share (v2.166.0); and the lockstep 'not synced' toast (v2.163.0). Each imports a TV-only system: LE/26, 27, 28, 32, 33, 37, 54, 59 and 66, VectorQuality, and SpecData lockstep.

findings.evidence: deps.py: 14 TV-only import files missing in VV for Toolbar; TV Toolbar__.js:35-127 log; TV Mount :423

findings.title: VV Panel__Text does not read the first of several selected
findings.detail: VV's 1.4.0 log claims the TV v2.57.0 port and defines Na__LePanelText__Many() (:121), but Refresh (:157-176) never calls it. With several text items selected the boxes show the new-text defaults, while edits still reach all of them through ApplyToSelection; the note keeps the old wording. TV's Refresh uses reading = selected || many and a TextNoneOfKindNote branch. The rest of the file is identical.
findings.recommendation: Take TV Panel__Text__.js 1.4.0 whole with a header seam (WP-S06a-01). Check: select three text items of different sizes; the panel shows the first one's size.
findings.evidence: VV Panel__Text__.js:121,157-176; Many() referenced 1x in VV vs 2x in TV

findings.title: Multi-select notes in AppConfig contradict panel behaviour (both apps)
findings.detail: TextManyNote, DimManyNote and ShapeManyNote in both AppConfigs (TV :852-854; VV :648,649,652) still say 'Click one ... on its own to edit it; these settings apply to new ...'. That was pre-v2.57.0 behaviour; edits now go to every selected item. Na__LeCfg__GetLabel prefers the config value over the code fallback (TV ConfigState__.js:372-375), so both apps show the wrong sentence. Leaders has no config key, so its correct fallback shows.
findings.recommendation: Replace the three values with the code fallbacks ('Editing {count} selected ...: a change here goes to all of them.') and add the three *NoneOfKindNote keys. Do it in VV (WP-S06a-01) and TV (WP-S06a-11).
findings.evidence: TV AppConfig__.json:852-854; VV AppConfig__.json:648,649,652; TV ConfigState__.js:372-375

findings.title: Panel__Leaders code identical; only comments and log differ
findings.detail: Both are at 1.2.0. TV has two extra comment blocks and a 1.1.0 log entry for the spec note row (v2.36.0), whose code VV already has. There is no behavioural gap.
findings.recommendation: Sync the header, log and comments from TV (WP-S06a-01).

findings.title: Dimensions panel lacks Measure at scale, Ext. lines, Round up, Line pt
findings.detail: VV 1.4.0 lacks: TV 1.2.0 Measure at scale (v2.40.0); 1.3.0 Ext. lines with the padlocked pair (v2.41.0), both recorded as skipped in the ledger, with atScale hard-coded true in ToolState (:153,162); 1.6.0 Round up to 5 mm (v2.139.0, TV-only 15__Core__Markup/DimensionRounding__); and 1.7.0 Line pt and Dashed lines (v2.152.0, which needs Dimension__LinePt/LineStyle, MarkupBridge SheetDimensionPt and LineStyleTool 'dim').

findings.evidence: Ledger lines 505-524 ('atScale rows skipped'); VV SheetTools__ToolState__.js:153,162; deps.py: MarkupBridge SheetDimensionPt missing

findings.title: Vectors panel: Edges-off on several selected repaints every fill (VV bug)
findings.detail: In VV, unticking Edges with several vectors selected writes one fill (the new-shape default) to all of them, so coloured rooms plus a line all come out the same colour. TV 1.8.1 (v2.106.0) takes the edges off and nothing else, through ApplyToSelection { stroked:false }. TV 1.8.2 (v2.116.0) keeps pictures out of what the panel reads; that is a no-op without Sheet Images.
findings.recommendation: Port the 1.8.1 and 1.8.2 hunks now (WP-S06a-01), ahead of the full panel port.
findings.evidence: TV Panel__Shapes__.js log 1.8.1/1.8.2; the TV hunk 'SEVERAL SELECTED: the edges come off' is absent from VV

findings.title: Vectors panel lacks Draw at scale and the Hatch block
findings.detail: VV lacks: TV 1.6.0 Draw at scale (v2.40.0; VV skipped it and hard-codes atScale); the Hatch block (v2.90.0, unversioned in the panel log); and its Pattern line pt, colour and Standard button (1.9.0, v2.126.0). These need TV-only LE/36__System__HatchPatternTools, Shape__Hatch in SheetRecords, the app-root 52__LayoutEditor__HatchPatternLibrary and 17 ShapeHatch and ShapeAtScale labels.
findings.recommendation: Take TV 1.9.0 whole after the hatch system and the atScale un-hardcode land (WP-S06a-07).
findings.evidence: deps.py: LE/36 HatchPatterns__ missing in VV; labels.py: 17 ShapeHatch*/ShapeAtScale* keys absent from VV AppConfig

findings.title: Layers panel lacks Ref switch, one-red states, Images/Floor Areas labels
findings.detail: VV 1.1.0 lacks: TV 1.1.1 type labels Images (v2.116.0) and Floor Areas (v2.104.0); 1.2.0 the Ref (reference layer) switch (v2.123.0); and 1.3.0 one faint red for Off, Unlock and Ref (v2.154.0). Ref needs the reference-layer feature (Layer__Selectable, IsLayerSelectable) across 17 TV modules: SheetModel, HitResolution, SelectionBox, ObjectSnap sources, ItemClipboard, LayerMenu and others. VV has none of them.
findings.recommendation: Now: the labels and the Off-red (WP-S06a-01). Later: TV 1.3.0 whole once reference layers exist (D-S06a-10, WP-S06a-09).
findings.evidence: TV Panel__Layers__.js:51-69 log; grep Layer__Selectable: 17 TV files, 0 VV; TV TYPE_LABELS :120

findings.title: Model Layers panel: phase rows and site plan columns are TV-only
findings.detail: VV 1.1.0 lacks TV 1.2.0, rows from the viewport's design phase via Model Source (v2.32.0), and 1.3.0, site plan layer rows (v2.49.0). It also lacks two unversioned site-plan-only columns: Fill (Na__LeEdge__FillHex) and Line scale (dashScale; EdgeStyles: 'Only a site plan layer carries one'). findings.evidence: TV Panel__ModelLayers__.js:42-48 log; TV EdgeStyles__.js:401

findings.title: Sheet panel: Drawing Type and Register routing are TV-only
findings.detail: Both are 1.4.0 with different content. TV has: the Drawing Type row (1.2.0, v2.48.0, site plans); Name and Revision routed through Na__LeRegEdit__Metadata (TV-only Drawing Register); and the DocumentId row hidden. VV keeps Drawing No. editable on purpose because it has no register. TV also blurs the name and field boxes on Enter (v2.115.0).

findings.evidence: git diff -w Panel__Sheet__.js (VV +48/-71); VV log 1.2.0 'DIVERGENCE FROM TRUEVISION, deliberately'

findings.title: Render Composites panel lacks the 'percent' weight kind
findings.detail: VV 1.6.1 lacks TV 1.7.0 (v2.93.0): a weight of kind 'percent' shows '%' and its own hint (Enhance Whitecard strength). It is harmless while no percent weight exists in VV's render composites config.

findings.evidence: TV Panel__Styles__.js log 1.7.0; git diff -w VV +17/-33

findings.title: Viewport panel 1.4.1 vs TV 1.10.0: Frame, Rotation, Doors, adoption missing
findings.detail: VV lacks: Frame (1.4.0, v2.38.0, Viewport__ShowFrame); Doors (1.5.0, v2.42.0, PlanDoors); Rotation (1.8.0, v2.138.0, ViewportRotation leaf); Hide swings and 1:200 (1.9.0, v2.140.0); and group adoption (1.10.0, v2.142.0, EditScope WithAdoption). Model Source (1.3.0) and site plans (1.6.0) are permanent divergences. VV's own 1.4.1 fix, which rebuilds the Add Viewport list on every refresh (:308-313), must survive.
findings.recommendation: Take TV 1.10.0 whole as dependencies land (WP-S06a-08). Re-apply VV's 1.4.1 hunk, exclude Model Source and site plans (via the D-S06a-02 shim or a seam), and add the 22 labels.
findings.evidence: git diff -w: VV +47/-529; TV log :58-108; VV :308-313; deps.py: ModelSource, PlanDoors, ViewportRotation, SitePlan Store missing
findings.vv_adaptation: Keep VV 1.4.1 add-list rebuild; no Model Source; no site plan branch

findings.title: Site Plan Composites panel is TV-only (site plans)
findings.detail: TV LE/40/Panel__SitePlanComposites__.js 1.0.0 switches a site plan viewport's three decks (fills, hatches, linework). Its port note reads 'goes to ValeVision3D with the site plan feature, if that is ever ported'. It imports TV-only 25__System__RenderStyles/SitePlanComposites.
findings.recommendation: Keep it absent in VV and record it as a permanent divergence tied to D-S06a-01.
findings.evidence: TV Panel__SitePlanComposites__.js:36-40 port note

findings.title: ModeController: left-column tabs, tab hints and 7 TV sections absent
findings.detail: TV registers: a left 'document' tab with a hint and the Specification tab (:521-522); a hint on Properties (:538); and seven sections VV lacks (Drawing Grid, Site Plan Composites, Specification Scrapbook, Vector Tools, Images, Patterns, Floor Areas), plus SpecLock. VV registers 14 sections with no left tabs and no hints (:409-436). The shared sections are already in the same order.
findings.recommendation: WP-S06a-04: add the left 'document' tab (registered first) and the Properties hint now. Add each other registration with its feature's work package, in TV's order.
findings.evidence: TV ModeController__.js:517-557; VV ModeController__.js:409-436

findings.title: Selecting a viewport leaves the markup sections open in VV
findings.detail: TV v2.106.0: SectionForKind(kind, items) returns FOLD_GROUP for a viewport (Patterns for one site plan viewport), and Floor Areas or Images for rooms and pictures (:1048-1068), so the markup sections fold over a selected drawing. VV's SectionForKind(kind) returns null for a viewport (:736-745), so Text, Dimensions, Vectors and Leaders stay open. PanelHost FocusSection(null) already folds the group in VV (same code).
findings.recommendation: Port the non-site-plan half now (WP-S06a-04): the FOLD_GROUP constant, the viewport branch and FocusSection(section || null). Add the Images and Floor Areas branches with those features.
findings.evidence: TV ModeController__.js:1036-1105; VV ModeController__.js:736-757

findings.title: AppConfig: accordion list and panel labels to add with each feature
findings.detail: LayoutEditor__Panels__AccordionSections is [text, dimensions, shapes, images, leaders, floor-areas, patterns] in TV (AppConfig:282) and [text, dimensions, shapes, leaders] in VV (:231). Label keys TV has and VV lacks: Dimensions 7, Layers 3, Shapes 17, ViewportSettings 22, Toolbar 4, Sheet 4, SitePlanComposites 3. Many other TV keys are fallback-only in both apps and need no row.
findings.recommendation: Each work package adds its own keys (report section d.3). Treat AppConfig.json as a hot file and serialise the work packages that touch it.
findings.evidence: labels.py output; TV AppConfig__.json:282; VV AppConfig__.json:231

findings.title: Scrapbook__.js: one site-plan seam; drift_all calls it header-only
findings.detail: Apart from the header and console prefix, VV equals TV 1.1.0. The single seam: VV hard-codes const type = 'architectural' (VV:188) where TV asks Na__LeModel__IsSitePlanSheet, and drops the SheetModel imports.

findings.detail: VV holds TV 1.2.0. It lacks 1.2.1 (v2.91.0): the Scrapbook tab carries spec.hint ('Ready-made, dynamic and saved items to drag onto the sheet.'), refreshed when the config lands. Seam: on a failed config read, VV shows the section on every sheet (:186); TV shows it only on site plan sheets.

findings.detail: VV holds TV 1.0.0. It lacks spec.caption (1.1.0, v2.91.0), needed by the Specification Scrapbook rows, and spec.hold/spec.snap (1.2.0, v2.134.0), needed by the Cabinet Infill's base point. 1.2.0 imports Na__LeOsnap__Snap and HideMarker from TV-only LE/28 ObjectSnap__Search. findings.title: Custom Scrapbook lacks the measured-room portability hunk
findings.detail: TV v2.104.0 (unversioned; the file is still 1.0.0) strips Area__Group and Area__ScaleDenominator from a saved measured room. It is guarded by if (copy.Shape__Area ...), so it does nothing in VV until Floor Areas lands. Otherwise the library is verbatim; only the item Meta description names the app.

findings.title: Custom Scrapbook transport: VV adaptation is correct (keep)
findings.detail: VV knows its server by /api/check-localhost ({isLocalhost:true}) instead of /api/health with a service name. It saves through /api/valevision/scrapbook and only counts answers that parse as JSON, because Whitecardopedia's catch-all answers unknown GETs with HTML and 200. On the live site both apps read the committed index; no R2 is involved.
findings.recommendation: Keep as a permanent DIV-4 divergence. No change.
findings.evidence: VV ScrapbookCustom__Transport__.js port note; WCP/server.py:322

findings.title: Scrapbook server blueprints are at logic parity
findings.detail: git diff -w of the two blueprints shows only the header and port note, the folder constants (TRUEVISION_APP_DIR vs VALEVISION_APP_DIR=../ValeVision3D), the blueprint name, the three route decorators and the index description. The category pattern, file naming, quarantine, size limits and allowed kinds are identical. Both blueprints are registered.
findings.recommendation: No action. When TV changes its blueprint, mirror the change into the WCP file, keeping VV's names.
findings.evidence: git diff -w of the two .py files; WCP/server.py:95-96; NAAPPS LocalServer:67,234

findings.title: TV scrapbook folders 02-05 missing on disk: saves there fail
findings.detail: TV's config lists five categories (ScrapbookCustom__Config__.json:22-27), but only 01__ScrapbookItems__General and 00__Deleted__Quarantine exist under TV/51__LayoutEditor__UserScrapbookContent. The server never creates a category, so saving into Dimensions, Annotations, 2D Entourage or General Notes fails in TV. VV tracks all five with .gitkeep. VV ledger row 84 flagged this; it is still open.
findings.recommendation: Back-port: create TV's 02-05 category folders, each with .gitkeep, and commit them (WP-S06a-11).
findings.evidence: find TV/51__LayoutEditor__UserScrapbookContent -type d (01 and 00 only); git ls-files VV content: 5 .gitkeep

findings.title: Whether VV's Custom library should carry TV's universal items
findings.detail: TV holds three items saved from RB05: GFFL (a 40 x 3.7 mm level-marker group), Leader Standards (2 leaders and 2 texts) and Test. Item files are portable key for key between the apps. VV's index is empty.
findings.recommendation: Ask Adam (D-S06a-05). If yes, copy GFFL and Leader Standards (never Test) into VV 01__ScrapbookItems__General and let the WCP server rebuild the index. Restyle to Vale fonts and colours if needed.
findings.evidence: TV UserScrapbook__Index__.json (3 items); VV index Items []

findings.title: Parametric engine is TV 1.2.0; lacks slide, choices, Refit, adopt, base
findings.detail: TV 1.7.0 adds: 1.3.0 slide point (v2.96.0); 1.4.0 choices, linkable:false and qr in ShapePatch (v2.100.0); 1.5.0 Refit (v2.122.0); 1.6.0 adopt (v2.128.0); and 1.7.0 BasePoint, Insert at 'base' and Regenerate origin (v2.134.0). decisions_needed.question: Will ValeVision ever have site plan drawings?
decisions_needed.options: (a) Never: Panel__SitePlanComposites, ModelLayers 1.3.0, ViewportSettings 1.6.0, the Sheet Drawing Type row, SiteLegend/Link and the Standard Scrapbook items stay out permanently. (b) Port TV's site plan system (LE/21, LE/25, OS data pipeline).
decisions_needed.recommendation: (a) for now. VV has no OS mapping pipeline. Record each item as a permanent divergence in the ledger.

decisions_needed.question: Give VV TV's drawing-type API as a stub so TV files port byte for byte?
decisions_needed.options: (a) Add Na__LeModel__DRAWING_ARCHITECTURAL='architectural' and DRAWING_SITEPLAN='siteplan', plus IsSitePlanSheet() and IsSitePlanViewport() returning false, to VV's SheetModel. (b) Keep per-file seams.
decisions_needed.recommendation: (a). It removes 6 seams in this slice alone and makes Scrapbook__, Panel__Scrapbook__ and the engine verbatim. The SheetData slice owns it.

decisions_needed.question: Should VV have the Project Portal QR block?
decisions_needed.options: (a) Leave it out. (b) Port it with a Vale link base and Vale wording, plus a VV QR system (LE/53) and the title-block QR.
decisions_needed.recommendation: (a) until Adam decides whether VV offers a public project viewer link: the whole QR system is NA's portal.

decisions_needed.question: Should the Standard Scrapbook carry Vale house items?
decisions_needed.options: (a) Stay empty. (b) Adam supplies Vale items (logo block, standard notes) as config pieces.
decisions_needed.recommendation: (a). Revisit when TV's parametric north point (TV plan phase 6) exists, and share that.

decisions_needed.question: Seed VV's Custom Scrapbook with TV's universal items?
decisions_needed.options: (a) No. (b) Copy GFFL and Leader Standards (the files are portable); never Test.
decisions_needed.recommendation: (b) if Adam wants identical libraries, restyled to Vale fonts and colours if needed.

decisions_needed.question: Should VV adopt TV's version numbers on whole-file ports?
decisions_needed.options: (a) Keep restarting at 1.0.0 (today's practice). (b) Adopt TV's number and log 'Ported from TrueVision3D x.y.z'.
decisions_needed.recommendation: (b). The header then says which TV state VV holds, which is what every future parity check needs.

decisions_needed.question: How should VV take Panel__ScrapbookParametric__, which statically imports NA-only and site-plan types, TV's CfApi client and the PWA context?
decisions_needed.options: (a) VV ports every dependency. (b) TV refactor (back-port): a per-app Na__LayoutEditor__ScrapbookParametric__Types__.js holds type registration, tools and the project-name resolver, so the panel becomes app-neutral. (c) VV keeps an adapted panel with a documented seam list.
decisions_needed.recommendation: (b) with (c) as the interim. It is the only way the 1,346-line panel stays verbatim across both apps.

decisions_needed.question: Adopt 1:200 in VV's architectural scales (revising VV decision D27)?
decisions_needed.options: Yes, matching TV v2.140.0; or no, keeping 1:20, 1:50 and 1:100.
decisions_needed.recommendation: Yes, for an identical experience. The config change belongs to the SheetData slice; the Viewport panel's wrapping toggle CSS comes with WP-S06a-02.

decisions_needed.question: Should plan doors (PlanDoors) and Hide swings come to VV?
decisions_needed.options: (a) Port PlanDoors; this needs a VV door data contract (realign plan row AA). (b) Leave them out.
decisions_needed.recommendation: Decide with the drawing-core slice. The Viewport panel rows follow automatically.

decisions_needed.question: Should reference layers (the Ref switch, TV v2.123.0) come to VV?
decisions_needed.options: Port them (17 TV modules), or leave them out.
decisions_needed.recommendation: Port them. They are universal and drive Panel__Layers 1.2.0 and ViewportLink 1.5.0.

decisions_needed.question: Should spell check and a Vale user dictionary come to VV, for the spec row editor?
decisions_needed.options: (a) Port 55__Feature__SpellCheck with a VV dictionary file and a WCP user-config blueprint. (b) Port the row editor without spell check.

decisions_needed.question: When should the shared service worker token (PWA_SW_VERSION_TOKEN) be bumped as these work packages ship?
decisions_needed.options: Bump per release, bump in batches, or never.
decisions_needed.recommendation: Bump once per VV release that adds exports. It is Adam's call, because a bump evicts every Vale app's caches.

decisions_needed.question: Should VV embed Open Sans in its PDF and text measurer (PdfFonts)?
decisions_needed.recommendation: Yes. Otherwise the DrawingTitle 5 mm rule, the Cabinet Infill boxes and the schedule widths are measured in Helvetica while drawn in Open Sans.
